bullets: Own and execute product-led growth across the full funnel, from acquisition to revenue.
Identify and prioritize high-leverage (80/20) opportunities that drive outsized growth.
Design and scale rapid experimentation loops across onboarding, activation, retention, and monetization.
Build repeatable, measurable growth loops, and improve first-time experience so users reach value fast.
Partner with marketing on paid acquisition, attribution, conversion, pricing, and packaging.
Define product opportunities across enterprise segments — customer profiles, workflows, jobs-to-be-done, and unmet needs in marketing, advertising, and entertainment.
Translate Luma's models, Canvas, Agents, and APIs into clear product definitions that serve real commercial customers.
Drive cross-functional execution across research, product, engineering, go-to-market, and forward-deployed teams in a pod structure.
Partner directly with enterprise customers in meetings to validate opportunities and shape direction.
Bridge market signals back to research so model prioritization reflects real commercial needs.
Define and execute end-to-end product strategy, translating user insight into AI-driven creative features.
Launch and iterate on pro-level photo and video tools, growing active users.
Deepen engagement through new features and agentic tools.
Lead cross-functional sprints, balance trade-offs, and keep a clear roadmap.
Run user research with professional creators to validate ideas and tune engagement loops.
